command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
grep -E ' (data/posebusters_paper_data\.zip|prep\.py)$' pins.sha256 | sha256sum -c || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out
obabel -V | tee /tmp/out/versions.txt
python3 -c "import rdkit; print('rdkit', rdkit.__version__)" | tee -a /tmp/out/versions.txt
python3 -u prep.py data/posebusters_paper_data.zip /var/tmp/prep 8 > /tmp/out/prep.log 2>&1
RC=$?
tail -n 30 /tmp/out/prep.log
cp /var/tmp/prep/manifest.tsv /var/tmp/prep/prep_failed.tsv /var/tmp/prep/prep_notes.tsv /tmp/out/
[ "$RC" = 0 ] && grep -q '^VINA PREP OK$' /tmp/out/prep.log || { echo "FAIL: prep exited $RC"; exit 1; }
tar -C /var/tmp -cf /tmp/out/prep.tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner prep
( cd /tmp/out && sha256sum prep.tar | tee prep.sha256 )
ls -l /tmp/out
echo DONE
